name: Casa Pestagua
positioning: Small 18th-century house hotel inside Cartagena's walled city, a Relais & Chateaux member with a pool at its heart and a private beach on Baru Island
best_for: Travelers who want to stay inside Cartagena's walled city in a restored colonial house
Couples looking for a suite with a private terrace and jacuzzi or a private balcony
Guests who want a city stay plus a private beach day on Baru Island

facts.text: Casa Pestagua was built in the 18th century and restored in 2022.
Casa Pestagua stands within Cartagena's walled city, a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
Casa Pestagua is a member of Relais & Chateaux and the Virtuoso portfolio.
Casa Pestagua blends colonial, republican and contemporary art.
The Suite Conde de Pestagua has exclusive elevator access.
The Suite de Madariaga has a private balcony.
The Grand Suite has two separate living spaces.
Rooms and suites have Frette bed linens and a pillow menu.
Housekeeping is twice daily, including turndown service.
Guests can extend the Acasi experience in six eco-cabins on the island.
AniMare brings together the culinary heritage of Colombia's Pacific and Caribbean coasts and is served beneath the Moorish arches of the colonial courtyard.

highlights.text: The Suite Conde de Pestagua has an expansive terrace with a jacuzzi overlooking Cartagena.
Acasi is Casa Pestagua's private beach on Baru Island.
The pool is at the heart of the hotel, surrounded by palms and Cartagena's native flora.
Rum tasting, cooking classes and coffee tasting are available on request, subject to availability.

considerations.text: Aurum Spa is not in the hotel itself; it is located at Casa San Agustin, Casa Pestagua's sister property, a few minutes away.
The hotel does not have twin or connecting rooms.
WhataHotel notes limited room inventory due to the hotel's boutique size.
